name: Theros
description: Theros is a plane of gods, heroes and monsters, modeled on Greek myth, where a pantheon of gods from Nyx watches over walled city-states.

description_citations.text: "Theros". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Theros is a plane of gods, heroes and monsters, modeled on Greek myth, where a pantheon of gods from Nyx watches over walled city-states.

citations.text: "Theros". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Its poleis, such as Akros, Meletis and Setessa, sit among monsters, and the gods are shaped by mortal belief.

citations.text: Theros: card flavor text (Theros, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
"Theros (plane)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"List of deities". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Elspeth Tirel came to Theros, slew the hydra Polukranos and became Heliod's champion.

citations.text: "Theros", section "Elspeth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Elspeth Tirel", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The planeswalker Xenagos attacked the poleis with otherworldly monsters, which led Kruphix to enact the Silence of the Gods.

citations.text: "Theros (plane)", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Xenagos", section "Return to Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Xenagos then ascended to godhood through the Great Revel, and Elspeth was scapegoated and exiled before she killed him in Nyx.

citations.text: "Theros (plane)", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Elspeth Tirel", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Heliod fatally wounded Elspeth with her own weapon, but she later defeated him, and Erebos imprisoned Heliod in the Underworld.

citations.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Elspeth Tirel", section "Beyond death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: During the New Phyrexian Invasion a Phyrexian Ajani led the first wave against the temples, and the gods, Heliod among them, were compleated.

citations.text: "Theros (plane)", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Angels from New Capenna then counter-invaded, and Kaya Cassir killed the compleated Heliod.

citations.text: "Theros (plane)", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth Tirel's spark ignites at thirteen.
timeline.quote: When she is 13, Elspeth Tirel 's Spark ignites

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heliod kills Elspeth Tirel in Nyx.
timeline.quote: Heliod kills Elspeth with her weapon.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth fights in gladiatorial pits in exile.
timeline.quote: she began fighting in gladiatorial pits, misusing her training as a knight to win.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Vengeance and Redemption". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth writes a letter to Ajani, intending to sink it in a swamp as a prayer.
timeline.quote: I'm going to roll the parchment up, slide it into a ceramic vial, and sink it in a swamp.

citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Elspeth arrives on Theros in a bleak swamp and is cared for by snake-loving priests in a cave temple.
timeline.quote: When I arrived this time, I ended up in a bleak swamp near an entrance to a cave.

citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Elspeth resolves to stay in the temple until she understands the gods of Theros.
timeline.quote: I am resolved to stay here until I understand the nature of the world and its divine stewards.

citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Champion and the philosopher Olexa went to the opposing camp and the enemy broke the siege.
timeline.quote: Behind them, the enemy raised sail and departed, breaking the siege.

citation.text: Traveling Philosopher (Theros, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Champion and companions pass through a forest of stacked stones.
timeline.quote: On the fourth day they passed through a forest of immense stacked stones.

citation.text: Silent Artisan (Theros, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Brygus the sentry was found dead and the Champion's supplies stolen.
timeline.quote: At sunrise, the Champion and her companions awoke to find their supplies gone and Brygus, their sentry, dead.

citation.text: Triton Shorethief (Theros, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Champion met Thyrogog of the Ashlands, who charged with Goremaster.
timeline.quote: The foul minotaur raised the great axe called Goremaster and charged.

citation.text: Felhide Minotaur (Theros, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Champion counted eight graves after a victory over the forces of Mogis.
timeline.quote: "I count eight graves," she said.

citation.text: Borderland Minotaur (Theros, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Khestes killed the giant Grinthax with an arrow despite being wounded.
timeline.quote: let fly the arrow that killed the giant Grinthax.

citation.text: Nessian Courser (Theros, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Champion stood alone between the Returned and the shrine to Karametra until temple guardians awoke.
timeline.quote: The Champion stood alone between the horde of the Returned and the shrine to Karametra

citation.text: Bronze Sable (Theros, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ajani tracks Elspeth to Theros.
timeline.quote: he tracked her to the plane of Theros

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Journey to Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth strikes down Xenagos in Nyx.
timeline.quote: the pair battled the god until at last Elspeth struck him down

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Journey to Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heliod murders Elspeth with her own weapon.
timeline.quote: Heliod appeared and used her weapon to murder Elspeth

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Journey to Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ajani reveals Heliod's murder in Meletis and spreads the message that gods are creations of belief; he earns his place among Theros's leonin.
timeline.quote: With that, he earned his place amongst the leonin of Theros.

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Journey to Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In ancient times the archons of Theros hold a massive empire in the Age of Trax, tyrannizing the world in the belief they imposed strict justice, until their empires fall.
timeline.quote: the archons of Theros held a massive empire, tyrannizing the world in the belief that they were imposing strict justice.

citation.text: "Archon", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heliod takes pity on an archon and gives it a spear in exchange for the rule of law in the wildest places.
timeline.quote: Heliod took pity on the archon and gave it a spear almost as radiant as his own

citation.text: "Archon", section "Archon of Falling Stars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dack takes a magical gauntlet from the Boros Legion's Sunhome, travels to Theros, finds the other half and defeats a kraken.
timeline.quote: Fayden slipped on the completed gauntlet, felt an ancient power within him, and defeated the sea creature.

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dack learns he will be affected by the Sleep Curse and enters Theros's Underworld.
timeline.quote: was last seen entering a portal to Theros's Underworld

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lidia takes Daxos to Athreos; he speaks and is revealed to be an oracle; Erebos sends Athreos to claim him.
timeline.quote: Athreos was sent to claim the child

citation.text: "Daxos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth, helped by Daxos, slays Polukranos, becoming Heliod's champion.
timeline.quote: Elspeth engaged the hydra with the help of Daxos and succeeded where many had failed, slaying it

citation.text: "Daxos", section "Godsend". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Daxos is freed from the Underworld as one of the Returned, searching for Elspeth.
timeline.quote: Daxos was freed from the Underworld in a cruel bargain with Erebos

citation.text: "Daxos", section "Daxos the Returned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth flees Heliod with the Sword of Chaos, which he later remakes into Godsend.
timeline.quote: he transformed the blade into a spear he dubbed Godsend

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth slays the hydra Polukranos and becomes Heliod's champion.
timeline.quote: Elspeth engaged the hydra with the help of Daxos and succeeded where so many had failed, slaying it.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Daxos realize their feelings after Akros is saved.
timeline.quote: Daxos and Elspeth finally realize their feelings for each other.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Great Revel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos controls Elspeth; she kills the Obliterator in her memory and realizes she has killed Daxos.
timeline.quote: only realizing too late that she had just killed Daxos

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Great Revel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heliod turns against Elspeth, believing she was part of Xenagos's plan.
timeline.quote: Heliod was wroth, believing she was implicit in Xenagos's plan, and sought to destroy her.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Great Revel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ephara destroys the newborn god Cacophony as a threat to social harmony.
timeline.quote: Ephara personally ended his existence.

citation.text: "Ephara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Silence of the Gods enacted by Kruphix, Ephara withdraws her direct presence from the world.
timeline.quote: Ephara — like her fellow deities — withdrew her direct presence from the world.

citation.text: "Ephara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Ephara appears in Elesh Norn's vision defending Theros and blesses its champions with godfire.
timeline.quote: She blessed the champions of Theros with divine flame

citation.text: "Ephara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Erebos is compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Erebos was compleated.

citation.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Theros, the gods battle the titans and seal them in the Underworld, where they remain until they break free.
timeline.quote: The gods of Theros battled them and sealed them away in the Underworld, where they remained until they broke free.

citation.text: "Giant", section "Titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Age of Trax Theros giants have kingdoms, and Agnomakhos uses the war against them as a pretext for evil actions.
timeline.quote: Agnomakhos used the war against the giants as a pretense for his evil actions

citation.text: "Giant", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heliod arms Kytheon and sends him after a Titan sent rampaging by Erebos, leading to his companions' deaths and his ascension as a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: It was Heliod who armed Kytheon (later known as Gideon ) and sent him after a Titan that Erebos had sent rampaging across Theros.

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heliod tries to burn Elspeth alive for her sword, fails, and makes her his champion, converting the blade into the spear Godsend.
timeline.quote: he saw fit to make her his "champion" and converted the weapon into a spear called Godsend .

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kruphix imposes the Silence of the Gods as the pantheon goes to war.
timeline.quote: Kruphix saw fit to prevent the gods from interacting with the mortals

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heliod blames Elspeth for Xenagos' apotheosis and tries unsuccessfully to kill her.
timeline.quote: Heliod was quick to blame Elspeth and once again tried to kill her, but failed.

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heliod resurrects Daxos as a demigod at great cost while seeking to become sole god.
timeline.quote: Heliod sought to become the sole god of the pantheon.

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Silence of the Gods leaves Iroas and the other deities unable to intervene in mortal affairs, creating challenges for his worshippers.
timeline.quote: Iroas was affected by the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Iroas", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In legend Karametra lays waste to her temples for a year and causes famine; humanity fasts and prays for seven days and she relents with a miraculous grape harvest.
timeline.quote: Moved by their sincerity, Karametra relented, blessing the world with a miraculous grape harvest that cured illness and ended the famine.

citation.text: "Karametra", section "The Years of Rage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians exploit belief on Theros, compleating followers and Heliod.
timeline.quote: it is known that Heliod was compleated and Ephara was not

citation.text: "List of deities", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth Tirel kills Xenagos.
timeline.quote: God of Revels. Killed by Elspeth Tirel .

citation.text: "List of deities", section "Minor gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In 4559 AR Xenagos gathers monsters to attack Meletis, Akros and Setessa, causing the Silence of the Gods.
timeline.quote: These attacks became so severe that the gods themselves went blind

citation.text: "Meletis", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Silenced like all Theros gods, Mogis circumvents the restriction by secretly aiding his oracle Rhordon in a duel with Anax shortly before the Great Revel.
timeline.quote: he circumvented this restriction by secretly aiding his oracle Rhordon during a duel with Anax

citation.text: "Mogis", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Silence of the Gods, Xenagos ascends through the Great Revel and imprisons Nylea in beast form.
timeline.quote: imprisoning Nylea in the form of a beast within her domain

citation.text: "Nylea", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Xenagos's fall Nylea's authority over Theros's wild places is restored.
timeline.quote: Nylea’s authority over the wild places of Theros was restored.

citation.text: "Nylea", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The archons of Trax dominate Theros and conscript the leonin into Agnomakhos's armies.
timeline.quote: the leonin, in particular, were forcibly conscripted into the armies of Agnomakhos .

citation.text: "Oreskos", section "Age of Trax". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Silence of the Gods leaves Pharika unable to influence mortal diseases or healing.
timeline.quote: Pharika was affected by the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Pharika", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phenax covertly supports Xenagos's apotheosis to subvert divine authority.
timeline.quote: He covertly supported Xenagos's apotheosis

citation.text: "Phenax", section "Divine Relationships". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Silence of the Gods prevents Phenax from influencing mortal affairs.
timeline.quote: which prevented him from influencing mortal affairs during that period

citation.text: "Phenax", section "Silence of the Gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phenax is strongly implied to have cursed Xandria, turning her into a siren after she fell in love with Ninis.
timeline.quote: It is also strongly implied that Phenax was the god behind the curse

citation.text: "Phenax", section "Silence of the Gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A Theran phoenix lays one egg in its life and plunges itself into its volcano at the end, upon which the egg hatches and a new phoenix is born.
timeline.quote: A phoenix lays just one egg during its centuries-long life

citation.text: "Phoenix", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Purphoros creates the Sword of Chaos to challenge Heliod; their battle disrupts the resting place of Polukranos, who rampages until Heliod and Nylea seal him.
timeline.quote: Purphoros once created the Sword of Chaos to challenge the sun god Heliod .

citation.text: "Purphoros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth Tirel arrives, witnesses Purphoros's sword being cast aside, claims it and departs.
timeline.quote: She claimed the sword for herself and later departed the plane.

citation.text: "Purphoros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Purphoros is among the gods affected by the Silence of the Gods.
timeline.quote: Purphoros was among the gods affected by the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Purphoros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A mortal steals Dekella to destroy a rival fleet and Thassa turns his family into eels (legend).
timeline.quote: Thassa turned his family into eels

citation.text: "Thassa", section "Divine weapon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kiora steals Dekella and Thassa receives a new divine spear from Purphoros.
timeline.quote: Dekella was later stolen by the planeswalker Kiora

citation.text: "Thassa", section "Divine weapon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth planeswalks from New Phyrexia to Theros, where snake priests of Pharika restore her strength.
timeline.quote: After planeswalking away from New Phyrexia , Elspeth finds herself on a vaguely familiar plane, Theros.

citation.text: "Theros", section "Elspeth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth kills a deadly hydra in a bitter battle, winning Heliod's notice.
timeline.quote: After a bitter battle, she emerges the victor.

citation.text: "Theros", section "Elspeth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heliod, noticing her feat, strives to make Elspeth his champion.
timeline.quote: Heliod, taking notice of her feat, now strives to make Elspeth his champion.

citation.text: "Theros", section "Elspeth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos's planeswalker spark ignites and he leaves Theros, later returning with a desire for power.
timeline.quote: until his planeswalker spark ignited and he was able to travel away from Theros

citation.text: "Theros", section "Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos resolves to enter the Therosian pantheon as a god.
timeline.quote: his mission now is to enter the Therosian pantheon as a god

citation.text: "Theros", section "Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos attacks the poleis with otherworldly monsters, blinding the gods, and Kruphix enacts the Silence of the Gods.
timeline.quote: Kruphix then enacted the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos ascends to godhood through the forced worship of a Great Revel after the siege of Akros, and Elspeth is scapegoated and exiled.
timeline.quote: Using the forced worhsip of mortal revelers, Xenagos managed to ascend to godhood.

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth offers her life for Daxos; Erebos accepts and Heliod fatally wounds his former champion.
timeline.quote: Elspeth offered her life in trade for her lover Daxos .

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth's Shadowspear is acknowledged as the true Khrusor, Heliod's spear shatters, and Erebos imprisons Heliod in the Underworld forever.
timeline.quote: Erebos imprisoned him in the Underworld forever

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "War of the gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth planeswalks away with Calix, whose spark ignites.
timeline.quote: Elspeth planeswalked away, with Calix, whose spark ignited in the meantime, following her.

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "War of the gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos ascends to godhood and is killed by Elspeth, revealing that the gods are replaceable.
timeline.quote: Xenagos ascended to godhood and was killed by Elspeth Tirel

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos's spark ignited during the Bakkeia and he became a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: this lifestyle led to his ascension, his spark igniting during the Bakkeia.

citation.text: "Xenagos", section "The Rise of King Stranger". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos returned to Theros and attacked Meletis, Akros and Setessa with otherworldly monsters, blinding the gods.
timeline.quote: These attacks became so severe that the gods themselves began to go blind, cut off from their oracles.

citation.text: "Xenagos", section "Return to Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zoe awakens from the grass beneath a slain hydra's blood and grieves for it.
timeline.quote: A blade had slain this majestic creature and it hurt Zoe

citation.text: "Nymphs of Theros". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Nylea speaks to Zoe in the olive grove and tells her to protect their home.
timeline.quote: We must protect our animals and our home from the folly and hatred of the humans.

citation.text: "Nymphs of Theros". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Dryads welcome Zoe into their dance, melting away her grief.
timeline.quote: The grief Zoe felt melted away.

citation.text: "Nymphs of Theros". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zoe watches a hunter be killed and the murderer consumed by two fiery nymphs.
timeline.quote: two fiery figures appeared and consumed her instantaneously.

citation.text: "Nymphs of Theros". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zoe speaks with the Oread nymph and learns of blood payment, then sends them away.
timeline.quote: Be gone, Oread Sisters. Leave our forest be.

citation.text: "Nymphs of Theros". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zoe meets the wheat-crowned meadow nymph who protects her flocks from warriors.
timeline.quote: Warriors have massacred my flocks before

citation.text: "Nymphs of Theros". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zoe meets the naiad at the lake and learns of humans' cruelty to water creatures.
timeline.quote: "No," whispered Zoe. "Humans."

citation.text: "Nymphs of Theros". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zoe finds the lampad in a dark cave who is waiting for a death.
timeline.quote: I'm waiting for a death. Do not disturb me.

citation.text: "Nymphs of Theros". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zoe lures a hunter with song to save a wolf, and he drowns in the stream.
timeline.quote: she saw the human figure sprawled out, drown in the stream.

citation.text: "Nymphs of Theros". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The lampad collects the dead hunter's soul and vanishes into the cave.
timeline.quote: Slowly, the nymph disappeared into the cave

citation.text: "Nymphs of Theros". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zoe returns to her olive grove and sings of her journey.
timeline.quote: A morning later, Zoe was back in her olive grove.

citation.text: "Nymphs of Theros". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.
